keyEvents.text: Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Elversberg 1, Mainz 0. Felix Keidel (Elversberg) from a free kick with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Elversberg 2, Mainz 0. Francis Onyeka (Elversberg) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by David Mokwa.
Danny da Costa (Mainz) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
